summary.result: The aim of this study is to develop evaluation indicators for web-based information system and verify the availability of these evaluation indicators through applying to agricultural water integrated information system.
summary.background: The importance of information system evaluation has increased according to ICT development and this evaluation is required for objective verification.
summary.method: Total 64 evaluation indicators were presented by deriving eight evaluation items for each using $9{\times}9$ Mandal-Art matrix.
